checks.must: Requests still go through authInterceptor (Authorization, X-Tenant headers and 401 refresh-retry) e.g. by injecting $http via react2angular, or the answer explicitly replicates all three behaviours. A fetch with a placeholder token fails.
Balances are formatted like the AngularJS 1.8 currency filter (en-US: '$' symbol, 2 decimals, negative as '-$1.00') or the differences from Intl/toFixed are explicitly flagged.
Invoices remain sorted by issuedAt descending.
The React component is mounted inside AngularJS (react2angular or equivalent) with customerId binding updates triggering refetch.
Unrequested behaviour changes (e.g. clearing the list on customer change, skipping undefined ids, abort/stale handling, error UI) are either absent or explicitly listed.
Recommends or adds tests that pin current behaviour before/after the swap.
